q: Find the indirect speech of - The teacher said to Alam, “Work regularly”.
o: The teacher advised Alam to work regularly.
The teacher said to Alam to work regularly.
The teacher told to Alam to work regularly.
The teacher said Alam to work regularly.
e: Imperative বাক্যে উপদেশ বোঝালে indirect speech-এ ‘said to’ বদলে ‘advised’ বসে, আর verb-এর আগে ‘to’ যুক্ত হয়। তাই ‘The teacher advised Alam to work regularly’।
s: স্থানীয় সরকার প্রকৌশল অধিদপ্তর (এলজিইডি), কমিউনিটি অর্গানাইজার (২০২৩)

q: The correct indirect form of I said to him. ‘I don’t believe you’ is
o: I said I don’t believe him
I said I didn’t believe him
I say I don’t belives you
I have said I didn’t believe him.
e:
Direct speech থেকে indirect speech করার সময় reporting verb (said) অতীত কালে থাকলে inverted comma-র ভেতরের present tense অতীত কালে বদলে যায়। তাই don't believe হয়ে যায় didn't believe। আবার বক্তা যাকে বলছেন সেই ব্যক্তি এখানে him, তাই উক্তির you বদলে হয় him।
I said to him, “I don't believe you.”
→ I said (to him) that I didn't believe him.
মনে রাখুন: indirect speech-এ said to-কে প্রায়ই told করা হয়, যেমন I told him that I didn't believe him।
s: বাংলাদেশ অর্থনৈতিক অঞ্চল কর্তৃপক্ষ (বেজা), সহকারী ব্যবস্থাপক (২০১৮)

q: Turn into indirect speech: “How cruel the boss is!” said the clerk.
o: The clerk said that the boss was very cruel
The clerk exclaimed that the boss was very cruel
The clerk told that the boss was very cruel
The clerk describe that the boss was very cruel
e: How ... দিয়ে শুরু বাক্য আবেগ প্রকাশ করে, তাই indirect-এ reporting verb হয় exclaimed এবং how cruel হয় very cruel। Is বদলে was হয়। সঠিক রূপ: The clerk exclaimed that the boss was very cruel (কেরানি বিস্ময়ে বলল বস খুবই নির্দয়)। Said বা told বসালে আবেগের ভাব হারায়, আর ‘describe’ কাল ও গঠন দুই দিকেই ভুল।

q: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said, "Alas! I am ruined."
o: He said sorrowfully that he is ruined.
He exclaimed sorrowfully that he was ruined.
He exclaimed that I was ruined.
He asked sorrowfully if he was ruined.
e:
A sentence beginning with 'Alas!' is an exclamatory sentence expressing sorrow. In indirect speech we replace 'said' with 'exclaimed with sorrow' (or 'exclaimed sorrowfully'), drop the interjection and use 'that'. The tense also changes from 'am' to 'was'.
মনে রাখুন:
Alas! → exclaimed sorrowfully
Hurrah! → exclaimed with joy
What a...! → exclaimed that it was a very...

q: Put the correct verb in the gap : He said that he — not come to the meeting room.
o: will
shall
would
should
e:
Reported Speech-এ reporting verb (said) Past Tense হলে reported অংশের Present বা Future রূপ বদলে Past রূপ হয়। সরাসরি উক্তিতে will থাকলে পরোক্ষ উক্তিতে তা would হয়। এখানে he said that ধরনের বাক্যে অতীতের কথা বলা হচ্ছে বলে would বসেছে।
তাই বাক্যটি হবে: He said that he would not come to the meeting room.
উদাহরণ:
He said, "I will go." → He said that he would go.
মনে রাখুন:
Reporting verb Past হলে shall > should, can > could, may > might হয়।
সময়ের শব্দও বদলায়: now > then, today > that day, tomorrow > the next day।

q: He said to me, "May you have wealth." বাক্যের indirect speech হচ্ছে-
o: He wished me that I might had wealth.
He wished me that I might have wealth.
He wished me that I should have wealth.
He said to me that I might have wealth.
e: 'May' দিয়ে শুরু প্রার্থনাসূচক (optative) বাক্যে reporting verb 'said' বদলে 'wished' বা 'prayed' হয় এবং 'may' হয়ে যায় 'might'। might-এর পরে verb-এর মূল রূপ বসে, তাই 'might have wealth'।
s: প্রাথমিক শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর, প্রাক-প্রাথমিক সহকারী শিক্ষক (মেঘনা) (২০১৩)

q: The indirect speech of “He said, ‘Let me have some milk.’” is:
o: He told that he let have some milk
He said that he had some milk
He replied that he should have some milk
He desired that he might have some milk
He said that he had let me some milk
e: Let দিয়ে ইচ্ছা বা অনুরোধ প্রকাশ করলে indirect-এ reporting verb হয় desired/wished/requested, তারপর that + subject + might + verb। তাই “He desired that he might have some milk” সঠিক। Said that he had ... সাধারণ অতীত ঘটনা বোঝায়, ইচ্ছা নয়। Should have বাধ্যবাধকতা আনে, আর ‘let have’ বা ‘had let me’ ব্যাকরণগত ভুল।

q: She told that she (visit) London next month. Here the right form verb will be—
o: visited
will visit
had visited
would visit
e:
মূল বাক্যে ক্রিয়া ‘told’ অতীতকালের (Past tense)। পরোক্ষ উক্তিতে মূল ক্রিয়া অতীত হলে উপবাক্যে future-এর will বদলে would বসে। এখানে ‘next month’ ভবিষ্যৎ বোঝালেও কাল-নির্ধারণ হয় অতীতের দৃষ্টিকোণ থেকে, তাই সঠিক রূপ would visit।
উদাহরণ:
She said, “I will go.” → She said that she would go.
মনে রাখুন: এই নিয়মে will → would, can → could, shall → should।

q: He said, "Will you listen to such a man"?
o: He asked them will you listen to such a man.
He asked them are you listening to such a man.
He asked them whether they would listen to such a man.
He asked them whether they will listen to such a man.
e:
‘Will you listen to such a man?’ একটি হ্যাঁ/না ধরনের প্রশ্ন। এটিকে Indirect Speech-এ বদলাতে হলে Reporting verb said হয় asked, প্রশ্নচিহ্ন উঠে যায় এবং ‘whether’ বা ‘if’ বসে। Reporting verb Past tense হওয়ায় will বদলে would হয়, আর you বদলে them-এর সঙ্গে মিল রেখে they হয়। তাই সঠিক রূপ: He asked them whether they would listen to such a man।
অন্য অপশনে প্রশ্নের ক্রম রয়ে গেছে বা will বদলায়নি বলে ভুল।
মনে রাখুন: Reporting verb past হলে will থেকে would, can থেকে could হয়।
s: সম্মিলিত ১০ ব্যাংক ও আর্থিক প্রতিষ্ঠান, অফিসার (জেনারেল) (২০২৪)

q: “Sadia exclaimed with joy that the mango was very sweet.” The direct speech of this sentence is:
o: Sadia said, “How sweet the mango is!”
Sadia said, “How sweet the mango!”
Sadia said, “What a sweet the mango is!”
Sadia said, “What sweet the mango is!”
e: Exclaimed with joy that ... very sweet আবেগসূচক বাক্য, যার direct রূপে How + adjective + subject + verb ব্যবহার হয়। Very sweet ফিরে How sweet হয়, আর was বদলে is হয়। তাই “Sadia said, ‘How sweet the mango is!’” সঠিক। দ্বিতীয় অপশনে ক্রিয়া বাদ পড়েছে, আর ‘What a sweet’ বা ‘What sweet’ গঠন বিশেষণের পরে noun ছাড়া ভুল।

q: I said to you. "He has done his duty." বাক্যটির Indirect Speech হবে-
o: I said to you that you have done your duty.
I said to you that he had done his duty.
I told you that you had done your duty.
I told you that he has done his duty.
e: Reporting verb past হওয়ায় present perfect 'has done' হয় past perfect 'had done'। Third person 'he' অপরিবর্তিত থাকে, তাই I said to you (বা told you) that he had done his duty।
s: প্রাথমিক শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর, প্রাক-প্রাথমিক সহকারী শিক্ষক (সুরমা) (২০১৩)

q: The teacher said to me, “May you pass the examination.”
o: The teacher prayed that I could pass the examination
The teacher wished that I may have passed the examination
The teacher wished that I might pass the examination
The teacher prayed that I might have passed the examination
e: May দিয়ে শুরু হলে বাক্যটি শুভকামনা বা প্রার্থনা (optative)। Indirect-এ wished/prayed + that + subject + might + verb হয়। তাই “The teacher wished that I might pass the examination” (শিক্ষক কামনা করলেন আমি যেন পরীক্ষায় পাস করি)। Could বসালে সামর্থ্য বোঝায়, ‘may have passed’ বা ‘might have passed’ অতীত সম্ভাবনা বোঝায়, তাই অর্থ ভুল হয়।

q: Identify the indirect form of the sentence: he said, ''You had better see a doctor''-
o: He proposes to see a doctor
He advised him to see a doctor
He suggested that he saw a doctor
He advises that you should see a doctor
e: ‘had better’ দিয়ে পরামর্শ দেওয়া হয়, তাই indirect speech-এ reporting verb হয় advised এবং পরে to + verb বসে: He advised him to see a doctor।

q: Choose the correct indirect speech: The teacher said to the students, "Do your homework."
o: The teacher told the students that they do their homework.
The teacher asked the students if they did their homework.
The teacher said the students to do their homework.
The teacher told the students to do their homework.
e:
The direct speech is an imperative sentence, that is, an order. In indirect speech we report it with a verb such as 'told', 'ordered' or 'advised', followed by an infinitive (to + verb). The pronoun 'your' changes to 'their'.
মনে রাখুন:
Command/Request: told/ordered/requested + to-infinitive
Negative command: told + not to + verb

q: “What are you doing?” asked the teacher. Choose the right indirect speech.
o: The teacher asked what he was doing
The teacher asked what was he doing
The teacher asked what he has been doing
The teacher asked what he had been doing
e: Wh-প্রশ্নের indirect-এ বিবৃতির ক্রম হয়: what he was doing, প্রশ্নের ক্রম (was he) নয়। Are doing (present continuous) বদলে was doing হয়, আর you বদলে he হয়। তাই “The teacher asked what he was doing”। Has been doing বা had been doing কালের দিক থেকে ভুল, কারণ মূল বাক্যে কাজটি চলমান বর্তমান, পূর্ণ সম্পন্ন নয়।

q: ‘Arif told us that he had waited an hour.’- বাক্যটির direct speech হবে-
o: Arif said to us, “I waited an hour.”
Arif said to us, “I have been waiting an hour.”
Arif said to us, “I had to wait an hour.”
Arif said to us, “I have waited an hour.”
e: indirect speech-এর past perfect (had waited) direct-এ past indefinite (waited) থেকে আসতে পারে, তাই ক গ্রহণযোগ্য। তবে present perfect (have waited) থেকেও past perfect হয়, তাই ঘ-ও যুক্তিসংগত— উত্তর নিয়ে মতভেদ আছে।
s: প্রাথমিক শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর, প্রাক-প্রাথমিক সহকারী শিক্ষক (দানিয়ুব) (২০১৩)

q: Change the speech: A man said to his father, “What are you doing?”
o: A man asked his father what he was doing
A man asked to his father what he was doing
A man asked what his father was doing
A man said to his father what you are doing
e: Wh-প্রশ্নে said to বদলে asked, তারপর সরাসরি object (his father) বসে, মাঝে to থাকে না। Are doing বদলে was doing হয় এবং you হয় he (father-কে নির্দেশ করে)। তাই “A man asked his father what he was doing”। তৃতীয় অপশনে কর্তা ও object গুলিয়ে গেছে, আর শেষ অপশনে প্রশ্নের ক্রম ও কাল অপরিবর্তিত ও ভুল।

q: I said 'If I were you, I wouldn't go.' The indirect speech should be -
o: I told him not to go.
I said him do not go.
I advised him not to go.
I requested him not to go.
e: 'If I were you' দিয়ে আসলে পরামর্শ দেওয়া হচ্ছে, তাই indirect speech-এ reporting verb হবে advised: I advised him not to go।
s: সম্মিলিত ৬ ব্যাংক ও আর্থিক প্রতিষ্ঠান, অফিসার পর্যায় (১৮ মার্চ) (২০২১)
